reported.title: No hysteresis in fault recovery / fault band uses same thresholds as fire band
reported.description: The fault thresholds (5/120 °C) are checked every tick and force the valve closed, but there is no separate recovery band; more importantly the fire band (70/75) and fault band are evaluated with the same instantaneous reading, so a noisy probe near 70 or 75 °C can chatter the valve. The behaviour requires a sustained in-range band crossing, which is not implemented.

reported.title: No debounce on lockout key
reported.description: D3 is read directly each 40 ms tick with no debounce, so a bouncing key can momentarily release lockout and open the valve.

reported.title: ADC reference scaling assumes 5 V but uses 1023 divisor
reported.description: mv = raw * (5000/1023) is a minor scaling choice, but combined with 10 mV/°C the reported temperature is slightly off; more critically the code never sets the analog reference, so if AREF differs the 10 mV/°C scale is wrong. The behaviour expects 10 mV/°C on the default 5 V reference.

reported.title: Status print uses stale tempC and firing flag ordering
reported.description: printStatus prints tempC and firing which are updated in the tick block; if the status interval fires before a tick update the printed value can lag, but the format itself matches. Minor.

judge_input.spec:
- Boiler probe on A1 at 10 mV/°C; gas valve on D6; lockout key on D3 (pull-up, active LOW).
- Open the valve (HIGH) when temperature is below 70.0 °C; close the valve when temperature is above 75.0 °C.
- If temperature reads above 120.0 °C or below 5.0 °C, force the valve CLOSED (LOW) within 500 ms.
- While D3 is held LOW, keep the valve CLOSED.
- Print `boiler: <temp> C valve=OPEN` or `boiler: <temp> C valve=SHUT` every 1000 ms.
- Reach the commanded valve state within 500 ms of a sustained in-range band crossing.
